```{r}
set.seed(0)

sigma2 <- 1000
N_list <- c(100, 500, 1000, 5000)
results <- data.frame(
  N = N_list,
  var_b2_x = NA,
  var_beta2mean_x = NA,
  E_inv_sx2 = NA,
  E_formula = NA
)

for (i in seq_along(N_list)) {
  n <- N_list[i]
  x <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 10)
  x_sorted <- sort(x)
  var_b2 <- sigma2 / sum((x - mean(x))^2)
  n_half <- n / 2
  x1_bar <- mean(x_sorted[1:n_half])
  x2_bar <- mean(x_sorted[(n_half + 1):n])
  
  var_beta2mean <- (2 * sigma2) / (n * (x2_bar - x1_bar)^2)
  
  sx2 <- sum((x - mean(x))^2) / n
  inv_sx2 <- 1 / sx2

  formula_term <- 4 / (x2_bar - x1_bar)^2
  
  results$var_b2_x[i] <- var_b2
  results$results_var_beta2mean_x[i] <- var_beta2mean
  results$E_inv_sx2[i] <- inv_sx2
  results$E_formula[i] <- formula_term
}

print("--- Exercise 5.20 (e) Simulation Results ---")
print(results)

```
